Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

To Support Data Integration Engineer – Informatica PowerCenter

Primary tool : Informatica PowerCenter and exposure of Informatica’s

other products and cloud-based data integration tools like Matillion

What a Typical Day Looks Like:

• 3 to 5 years of experience in Data Warehousing environment with very strong

knowledge of Data Integration, migration & replication by using Informatica

PowerCenter/products, Oracle, Snowflake & Unix shell scripting

• Proficient in Data modelling & Strong Exposure to Data Warehousing

Concepts.

• Implementation of larger Data Warehousing/Data Lake projects
• Strong hands-on experience on Databases including PL/SQL & SQL
• Hands on experience in SQL query tuning, query re-writing & fine tuning
• Preferred to have exposure on cloud data integration tools
• Able to write the complex Unix shell and Python scripts
• Good Written & Verbal Communication.

The Experience We’re Looking to Add to Our Team:

• Hands on experience of Informatica Power Center and other products,

preferred to have worked on CDC (Change Data Capture) environment

• Strong knowledge of Oracle, SQL server, postgres & Snowflake database and

write/optimizing complex SQL queries

• Experience with scripting languages such as Unix Shell and Python
• Strong knowledge of data analysis, data transformation, conceptual data

modelling, data transformation and metadata management.

• Preferred to have knowledge on Qlik Replicate, Big data, APIs, and Cloud data

integration tools experience

• Experience in handling various file types for sending/receiving data

(CSV/API/XML/JSON/AVRO)

• Should be proficient enough to design and develop ETL for any data

warehouse projects

• Should have very good technical skills to optimize/tune the SQL queries or

workflow to reduce cycle times to process huge data set

• Understanding of industry standards for data security and privacy
• Must have good communication and problem-solving skills
• Design and Develop Informatica mappings, mapplets and workflows using

Informatica products

• Share the workload and flexible enough to get into other technologies as

applicable and need basis

• Coach and guide other members in the team and implement best practices

and automate some of routine day to day activities

• Prepare High & Low-level design documents and Test cases for various Data

Warehousing projects.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Analyze data requirements, data model and determine the best methods in

extracting, transforming, and loading the data into the data warehouse and

other system integration projects

• Perform source system analysis and design the extract logic
• Architect the solution, Code Design, Implement and continuously expand data

pipelines by performing extraction, transformation and loading activities

• Investigate data to identify potential issues within ETL pipelines
• Write SQL scripts to perform data comparison checks to unit test data

integration jobs

• Prepare high- and low-level design documentation
• PoCs for various Data Integration uses cases by using various Data

Integration tools and Databases.

• Write Shell scripts or Python scripts for various in-house automation activities

What You’ll Receive for the Great Work You Provide:

• Health Insurance
• Paid Time Off (PTO)

Key Responsibilities:
• Monthly Results Variances and Commentary – Develop reports and analyses to isolate significant P&L variances to budgets. Coordinate with NBL-level controllers and business leaders to collect commentary on root causes and action plans; consolidate into summaries that are appropriate for GSC and GOC-level review.
• Forecasting and Budgeting Coordination and Support - Coordinate with businesses to collect quarterly forecasts and consolidate submissions for analysis and GOC-level reporting. Support annual operating budgeting processes, including collection and analysis of budget submissions. 
• Net Working Capital Analysis - Streamline and improve existing NWC reporting tools and analyses. Work with business teams and NSC as needed to identify and comment on significant changes in NWC. Support the sharing of NWC tools and reports with NBL-level leadership.
• Price and Profitability Analysis – Provide support for revenue and profitability analysis initiatives. This includes collecting, reviewing and processing data for price and productivity variance analyses and sub-business profitability analyses by test or customer classification. 
• Cost Center Reporting and Analysis -Identify improvements to cost center reporting processes that ensure better alignment Eurofins reporting policies. Create tools and processes to track performance by cost center and improve accuracy of cost center reporting. 
• Ad Hoc Projects & Leadership – Support other FP&A analysis projects as required, such as analysis of financial improvement and investment opportunities. Provide mentoring and support to junior analysts. 
Qualifications: 
• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or a related discipline (mandatory).
• In Addition, One of the Following is Required:
• Master’s degree in finance, MBA or equivalent advanced qualification, (OR)
• Minimum intermediate level passed professional certification (e.g., CFA, CPA, CMA, or any equivalent certification). (OR)
• Diploma in IFRS
• Experience: Minimum 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, business finance or financial reporting, preferably in ITES, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or related sectors.
• Technical Skills: 
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (complex functions, pivot tables, macros) and financial modeling.
• Experience working with Accounting, ERP and Business Intelligence systems. 
• A solid understanding of GAAP and three-statement financial modeling. 
• Communications: The ideal candidate should possess excellent verbal and written communication skills and be able to clearly communicate financial concepts with non-finance stakeholders. 
• Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong quantitative and analytical skills; can translate data into actionable recommendations. Entrepreneurial problem solver who finds a way to get things done.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with business leaders and controllers across multiple business lines and geographies.

About the Team
ValMo is Meesho's logistics and supply chain organization, building India's most cost-efficient, reliable, and scalable fulfillment network. From first-mile pickup to last-mile delivery and reverse logistics, ValMo powers millions of shipments every month for small businesses across the country.
As we scale, network complexity grows exponentially. ValMo sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and partner ecosystems — where execution precision and systems thinking are critical to prevent cascading failures across the network
About the Role
Lead the national expansion of our hyperlocal self-pickup network: Meesho Pickup Point. We are partnering with local Kiranas, pharmacies, and telecom shops to serve as highly dense, zero-effort pickup points for our prepaid customers.
This is a national-level role reporting into senior leadership, where you'll shape the operations strategy for scaling this network across India.
 


What you'll do
• 

Define and execute the strategy for scaling the Meesho Pickup point network nationally

• 

Design and refine partner onboarding processes to grow and sustain the delivery network

• 

Own service quality and cost metrics for last-mile operations, and drive continuous improvement against them

• 

Build and lead a team of cluster managers and team leads; set vision, direction, and culture, and manage individual and team performance

• 

Identify operational gaps and drive data-led process improvements

• 

Partner with cross-functional teams — tech, supply, finance, city ops — to implement strategies that optimize cost, service levels, and scalability

• 

Manage a large, diverse frontline workforce across geographies with varying operating contexts

•

What you'll need
• 

• 

Graduate or postgraduate degree in any discipline

• 

5–7 years of experience in e-commerce logistics or hyperlocal delivery

• 

Proven experience in process design and operations implementation, preferably within logistics or supply chain management

• 

People leadership experience, ideally managing frontline/blue-collar workforces such as delivery executives

• 

Strong structured problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented, customer-first mindset

• 

An entrepreneurial, go-getter attitude — comfortable building processes in ambiguity and owning outcomes end to end

Job Description

Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer 

Experience: 5+ Years

Location: Pune, India (Work From Office)

Salary: Best in Industry

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Mode: Work From Office (Pune)

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer with expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG systems, and production-grade machine learning. The candidate will design, develop, deploy, and optimize AI-powered applications and scalable ML solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop AI/ML and Generative AI applications.
• Build and deploy LLM-based solutions using OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama, etc.
• Create RAG pipelines using vector databases.
• Implement AI agents, prompt engineering, and workflow automation.
• Design scalable ML pipelines and production AI services.
• Deploy and monitor models using MLOps best practices.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI solutions.
• Optimize model performance, scalability, and infrastructure costs. 

Required Skills

• Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn
• Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex
• OpenAI APIs and LLM frameworks
• RAG, AI Agents, Chatbots, NLP, Deep Learning
• Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Milvus
• Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Airflow, CI/CD
• FastAPI or Flask
• PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis 

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's/Master's degree in CS, AI, ML, or related field
• 5+ years in AI/ML Engineering
• 2+ years in Generative AI/LLM development
• Experience deploying AI systems at scale 

Nice to Have

• CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, Haystack
• Ollama, vLLM, ONNX, TensorRT
• Experience with Voice AI, Computer Vision, or Multimodal AI 

Skills: openair, Python, gen AI, MLflow, FastAPI, rag, nlp, ml
